criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, notable for their activities in fields such as politics, sports, arts, or history.

categories.name: Settlement
categories.definition: A community or populated place where people live, such as a village, town, or city.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural physical formation on the Earth's surface, such as a mountain, river, lake, or volcano.

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: An organization or establishment dedicated to education, such as a school, college, or university.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: An organized body of people with a particular purpose, such as a company, bank, charity, or government agency.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A machine used for transporting people or cargo, including ships, aircraft, automobiles, and trains.

categories.name: Building and Structure
categories.definition: A man-made construction, such as a building, bridge, church, or other physical structure.

categories.name: Musical Work
categories.definition: A creative work consisting of recorded music, such as an album, single, or compilation.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture or television production, including feature films, documentaries, and specials.

categories.name: Written Work
categories.definition: A literary composition intended to be read, such as a novel, book, play, or short story.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A periodical or serial publication such as a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

categories.name: Animal
categories.definition: A living organism belonging to the kingdom Animalia, or a taxonomic group of such organisms.

categories.name: Plant
categories.definition: A living organism belonging to the kingdom Plantae, including trees, shrubs, and algae, or a taxonomic group of such organisms.

categories.name: Concept
categories.definition: An abstract idea, term, or definition.
